why: rc34: one Sizes page, one slider per group of texts

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc34 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Change: every size slider now lives on ONE new settings page, "Font sizes", and each slider moves exactly one group of texts - no slider multiplies into another any more.
- Font size (9 to 20): the Persian texts the addon draws itself (tooltips, spell and talent descriptions, the quest window). It no longer touches the quest list or the game's own texts.
- Quest list and tracker (70 to 200 percent, default 110): only the quest list beside the map (M) and the tracker. Before, the General font size also multiplied in.
- Game texts, English too (70 to 160 percent, default 110 = the game's own size): only with "Persian font in the whole game" on. The switch moved to this page too. Before, the General font size also multiplied in.
- Chat, red alerts and the settings window each keep their own slider, now on the same page, each with one line saying what it moves.
Profiles now save these sliders too.
Includes rc7 to rc33.
